2607.02512.title: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
2607.02512.paper_summary: Many everyday programming tasks resist clean rule-based implementation, such as alerting on important log lines, repairing malformed JSON, or ranking search results by intent, and are increasingly outsourced to large language model APIs at the cost of locality, reproducibility, and price. We propose fuzzy-function programming: compiling such a function from a natural-language specification into a compact, locally-executable neural artifact. We instantiate this paradigm with Program-as-Weights (PAW), in which a 4B compiler trained on FuzzyBench, a 10M-example dataset we release, emits parameter-efficient adapters for a frozen, lightweight interpreter. A 0.6B Qwen3 interpreter executing PAW programs matches the performance of direct prompting of Qwen3-32B, while using roughly one fiftieth of the inference memory and running at 30 tokens/s on a MacBook M3. PAW reframes the foundation model from a per-input problem solver into a tool builder: invoked once per function definition, it produces a small reusable artifact whose subsequent calls per function application are cheap and offline.
2607.02512.paper_summary_zh: 許多日常的程式設計任務難以進行乾淨的基於規則的實現，例如對重要日誌行進行警報、修復格式錯誤的 JSON，或根據意圖對搜索結果進行排名，這些任務越來越多地外包給大型語言模型 API，代價是地方性、可重複性和價格。我們提出模糊函數編程：將這樣的函數從自然語言規範編譯成緊湊的、本地可執行的神經工件。我們用 Program-as-Weights (PAW) 實現這一範式，其中一個在 FuzzyBench 上訓練的 4B 編譯器，這是一個我們釋放的 10M 範例數據集，為一個凍結的、輕量級的解釋器發出參數高效的適配器。一個 0.6B 的 Qwen3 解釋器執行 PAW 程式的性能與直接提示 Qwen3-32B 相匹配，同時使用大約五十分之一的推理記憶體，並在 MacBook M3 上以每秒 30 個標記的速度運行。PAW 將基礎模型從每個輸入的問題解決者重新構建為工具構建者：每次函數定義時調用一次，它產生一個小型可重用的工件，其後每次函數應用的調用都是便宜且離線的。
